messages:
Marco: heads-up — packaging job 782 failed on the final bundle split step, saw a checksum mismatch for payload chunk 3
DeployBot: packaging job 782 failed: exit status 1 — checksum-mismatch chunk=3, artifact=redwood-private-installer-v2.9.1.tar.gz
Marco: logs attached below, looks like the chunking script wrote two different content-lengths intermittently
Marco: ```
2024-04-28T03:20:11Z chef: split -> chunk-3 size=2147483648 sha256=aa12...
2024-04-28T03:20:12Z chef: split -> chunk-3 size=2147481600 sha256=bb34...
```
Sophie: yikes, that's the artifact we planned to ship in the midnight window. Any chance this is a streaming/flush race?
Anya: possible. Last time we saw this it was the gzip step writing variable metadata when buffer hit the turbo limit. Can you share the packaging config?
Marco: using `./scripts/package.sh --split=4 --compress=gzip --stable-ids` on staging-host-4
Tayler: @Sophie we should consider rolling forward with v2.9.2 (bump patch, regenerate). If chunking is nondeterministic, repack could fix it. But we need a verification gate first.
Sophie: Agreed. Two options: (A) rollback to v2.9.0 (older image) for delivery slot, or (B) regenerate v2.9.2 and run a deterministic checksum pass + cosign verify before release. I prefer B if we can validate quickly.
DeployBot: suggested action: create candidate v2.9.2, run `packaging/verify.sh` (sha256 + cosign), then schedule canary at 23:00 UTC. Approve? (reply `approve` / `abort`)
Anya: quick triage — I can run a deterministic repack on a clean host and run the verify script. ETA 25m.
Marco: I've queued the repack on clean-host-9, switching gzip to `--no-timestamp` and pinning block size. Will push artifacts to staging-s3 under `releases/v2.9.2-candidate/`.
Sophie: add cosign signing step and post the `cosign verify` output to the thread. Need KMS key id used.
Marco: done. cosign key: projects/redwood-kms/private-release-1. Repack job log: ```
Uploading releases/v2.9.2-candidate/redwood-private-installer-v2.9.2.tar.gz
sha256: 3f7a9c...
chunk-3 sha256: 3f7a9c...
cosign: signature verified for releases/v2.9.2-candidate/redwood-private-installer-v2.9.2.tar.gz
```
Tayler: run `packaging/verify.sh` then `releasebot create-tag v2.9.2` (dry-run) and run smoke deploy to staging cluster.
DeployBot: packaging/verify.sh completed: all shards matched; cosign verified. Next step: staging smoke deploy requested by Anya.
Anya: staging smoke deploy succeeded: startup checks green, KV-store warmed, ingress tests passed. Logs: `smoke: ok 42/42`
Sophie: good. Ops question: do we need to change the delivery manifest pin for private customers who requested the v2.9.1 pin? Some customers have pinned to `installer:v2.9.1` in their onprem manifests.
Marco: We'll publish a `v2.9.2` variant and leave device pin `v2.9.1` unchanged. For customers on strict pin, ops will coordinate manual uplift. For bulk delivery we'll ship `v2.9.2` and mark it as recommended.
Tayler: Decision: rollforward with v2.9.2 candidate -> promote to GA after 2 hour canary. Canary window set to 2h, metric thresholds: error-rate < 0.5% and median start-latency < 1200ms. If thresholds breach, automatic rollback to v2.9.0 (not v2.9.1) while we investigate.
Sophie: I'm giving signoff for the repack and canary schedule. @DeployBot schedule deploy at 23:00 UTC and lock change window to 02:00 UTC (2h).
DeployBot: scheduled: private/installer rollout v2.9.2 -> rollout start 2024-04-28T23:00:00Z, canary window 2h, rollback target on failure: v2.9.0. Ticket: RB-1452
Marco: note for release notes: mention deterministic repack to address chunking nondeterminism + cosign verification. Also add migration note for customers pinned to v2.9.1.
Sophie: I'll draft release notes and post to `eng-releases` and `customer-success` by 21:30 UTC.
Anya: leaving follow-on tasks: (1) add unit test for gzip non-determinism (2) instrument split writer to emit content-length hash every 10s (3) add packaging job retry on transient write mismatch.
Tayler: added tasks to RB-1453, RB-1454, RB-1455 respectively.
Sophie: final check — any objection to proceeding?
Marco: :thumbsup:
Anya: :eyes:
Tayler: approve
Sophie: proceeding with rollforward. I'll post final release note link when ready. :rocket:
